firstPlayerRule: For a standalone multiplayer game of Episode 1, whoever was most recently on a boat goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Preliminary Settlement and Influence placement runs in reverse: start with the last player and proceed counterclockwise.
Episode 2 has a different criterion. This entry does not cover the separate Chronicle campaign or solo mode.

The cover explicitly identifies two standalone episodes in the Episodes 1 & 2 box, so this and Episode 2 map to one inventory identity rather than two completed games.
